title: GT transfer + re-optimised lazy-descent STNFS core (line sieve from 2^14, Q_b <= (17/20) A^2 - Q_a), clean runs: 122.491097727587363

claims.statement: proof.md's algorithm returns x for uniform T=[x]P0 with success >= 0.39 under heuristics H1-H5: z=e(T,Q0) against a randomized base g=e(P0,Q0)^b, the charged field map, a=log_g(z) by the GT STNFS core, ba mod r checked by [ba]P0=T. Core: our valid plain P10b's, re-optimised (line sieve from 2^14, trial division below 2^20, slacks (302, 233), region Q_a <= (2895/8000) A^2, Q_b <= (17/20) A^2 - Q_a sized on pool S and judged once on a fresh pool G, relations >= 2^63.6232 after a 0.009-bit band charge), clean-run rec7: collection <= 2^118.895525055, N(300)/U 0.03577 (PREREG-H, 2^19/2^20), Horner chains from Krylov checkpoints, linear algebra <= 2^116.481352797 (seven owners; |c| in {2,3,4} as |c| unit entries, PREREG-K; 64-bit left Block Wiedemann vectors, failure <= 0.0244555 charged in success), generator <= 2^107.988885764, meter 2^113.303 (success >= 0.39 at +10% descent work); ledger rows sum to at most 2^119.16916963270 <= 2^119.1691696327 dense-Fp12 units (C=20,000). All classical work is at most 10 x 2^119.1691696327 + 2^80/2000 < 2^122.491097727587363 G1 units (C=2,000). Storage below 2^106 bytes; no advice or amortization. Analytic exploratory claim.

experiments.purpose: Hosted audit. {}: code identity, parameters, recorded full-run certificate, integration probes, lazy bound vs a simulation, core ledger and success, G1 conversion (80-digit), base-randomisation bijections; {"descent": true} also re-evaluates the descent. evidence16.py (local, ~3 minutes) reruns every check.

filtsim.py (purge 0.0001, excess 1.05 or 'excess') at the shipped means to weight 100/200/300 (default): +-1 share (charged 0.87), |c| in {2,3,4} shares, five-vector cost k5 (charged 12.47, PREREG-K) and U/N, at its scale only (H4u, H3).
